bounded_hostile_questions.question: Is the source ordinate an evaluated continuous physical spectrum?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: No. It is the stated energy-weighted histogram of finite positive saved quadrature; sparse empty bins make no continuous-zero claim.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Does aggregation preserve saved energy and normalization?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: Weights retain per-absorbing-target per-proper-second units; histogram sum residual <= 6.5607210040808844e-15 and all derived numerical files are unchanged across revisions.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Is finite FS energy coverage presented as physical deposition?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: No. Captions preserve composition/stopping admission and thermal/radiative closure as open, with global_error_bound null.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Are small tails and missing source support hidden?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: No. Above-FS finite-source fractions are printed; photon-fit support ends at 50 keV; injection from higher photons is unresolved rather than set to zero.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Are mean-line and endpoint measures described as evaluated beta spectra?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: No. Both figures and captions explicitly label mathematical diagnostics with equal rest count/mean and allowed support interval.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Does the plot imply interpolation in u or response accuracy?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: No. Only eight saved u positions per witness are plotted, with no connecting lines and with the categorical spacing and visual offsets disclosed; interpolation_accuracy_claim=false.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Are both publication widths actually usable?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: Yes within visual-review scope. 90 mm source fractions use a table; boost panels are stacked. Minimum recorded text is 8 pt and all visible text boxes are inside the canvas. Root independently inspected all four v3 PNGs.

bounded_hostile_questions.question: Are C23A D1 and C23B spectra or model conventions mixed?
bounded_hostile_questions.answer: No. Six exact saved C23B CSV/JSON input pins are the only numerical inputs. D1 is not consumed. Fit thresholds are identified as adopted rounded fit parameters.

bounded_residual_questions.question: Was the v1 clipped y-axis label repaired without shrinking the font?
bounded_residual_questions.answer: Yes; physical-mm left margins were enlarged; final minimum text is >=8 pt at each width.

bounded_residual_questions.question: Do legends, panel titles, axis labels or footers still overlap?
bounded_residual_questions.answer: None were found in actual v3 PNG review; dedicated bands are used, and source legend has opaque white backing.

bounded_residual_questions.question: Can a tiny high-energy fraction be mistaken for exact zero?
bounded_residual_questions.answer: The high fractions are written numerically in both layouts; the 90 mm plot uses an explicit table.

bounded_residual_questions.question: Did any repair change numeric data or rerun physics?
bounded_residual_questions.answer: The three numerical products are byte-identical across v1-v3; boost PNGs v2-v3 are byte-identical; source/ODE/transform calls remain zero.

bounded_residual_questions.question: Was the exported PDF inspected as well as the PNG?
bounded_residual_questions.answer: PDF page dimensions, text and extracted embedded font bytes were checked. Separate PDF rasterization was NOT_RUN. The actual visual surface was the corresponding Matplotlib PNG, independently reviewed by root.
